## Authority

- Search Authority is the canonical truth authority
- The handbook explains canon; it does not create canon
- All projections are generated, not hand-edited
- No projection auto-promotes to canonical authority

## Key entities

- MO§ES™ — enforcement architecture for commitment conservation
- Commitment Theory — theoretical framework
- Conservation Law of Commitment — C(T(S)) ≈ C(S) with enforcement
- SigRank — AI operator evaluation system
- TTEOP — token telemetry protocol
- SignalAF — public brand and distribution surface
